examples.label: Verify configured exports on the NFS server

notes:
Config: /etc/exports
Ports: 111/tcp+udp (rpcbind), 2049/tcp+udp (NFS)
Dangerous export options: rw, insecure, nohide, no_root_squash (keeps root -> SUID abuse)
Files worth grabbing: id_rsa, *.priv keys, backup.sh, nfs.share

recommended.note: Enumerate NFS exports, mount and inspect contents

name: Reference - NFS Ports & Dangerous Settings
description: NFS export config, ports, and the export options that enable SUID abuse / privilege escalation.
